sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture off the back of a recent loss but remain in strong form overall, having won 7 of their 10 matches so far. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are in dire form, having won only once in their last five games, making this a favourable matchup for Sandbach to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second in the table with 20 points, travel away to Dawley Town in what represents an opportunity to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between third and fifth place, with both teams looking to maintain their strong positions. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain struggling Wednesfield Community at home; the Casuals have won two of their last three matches and will be favoured. Foley Meir face Bilston Town in an encounter between mid-table sides, with Bilston in better form. Cheadle Heath Nomads, near the bottom, must travel to Telford Town in a crucial fixture for both struggling sides. Brereton Social host Widnes Town at the bottom of the pile—Widnes remain pointless in the division and without a win in their opening seven games. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath; both sides have struggled this season but will hope for an upturn. Shawbury United are in freefall with six consecutive losses and face Barnton away, while Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a match between sides in the lower half of the table.
